question: Does the same percentage preset do the same damage to every file?

method.master: /tmp/crfsrc/camera.mp4 — 1920x1080, 29.97 fps, 10.01 s, 25.1 Mbps. The same master scripts/crf-sweep.mjs uses (sourceHash b23aa16c11d5). High-motion, noisy handheld footage, i.e. the demanding end of the range.
method.encoder: local ffmpeg, libx264, preset faster, ABR with maxrate 2x / bufsize 4x, AAC 128 kbps
method.note: Two references are reported. 'vsMaster' shows absolute quality. 'vsOwnSource' is the one the product cares about: how much worse the output is than the file the user already had.

conclusion: Identical preset, identical content: judged against the file the user brought us, Balanced scores 80.4 on a source with slack and 38.1 on one that is already lean. The preset is a statement about file size and says nothing about how much room the video had, which is why the UI now checks before running.
